svg.title: D09 Compliance and evidence architecture
svg.text: Customer or contract obligations use the same
Today a rule is edited in place. Proposed:
— old evaluations keep their rule version.
AND / OR / NOT nodes with typed parameters.

Document revisions are rows, not overwrites. Each evaluation stores the configuration it saw and its reasoning trace, so a past decision can be re-derived and compared. Gaps: rule edits are not versioned and the system / human /
final decision chain of ADR-005 is not in the schema (finding F8).
D09 · COMPLIANCE & EVIDENCE — SOURCE → INTERPRETATION → LOGIC → OUTPUT
